[[File:Goddess_of_Safety.png|thumb|right|150px|Two statues of the goddess in front of the Theed hangar exit]]
A '''goddess''' of safety was an ancient allegorical deity worshiped on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Statues of this mythological figure stood on the cliff side of the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] exit&mdash;and possibly also on the hangar's domed roof&mdash;to ensure a feeling of security.
